name: hoiku-recipe
description: 保育園児の親向け献立自動生成アプリ

scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && py -3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
